opening.fr: Pourquoi la messe est-elle un sacrifice ?
opening.en: The Mass is truly a sacrifice because the sacrifice of Christ upon Calvary is made present sacramentally. It is the same victim, Christ Himself, offered in an unbloody manner.

question.en: Does Christ have to die again?
question.fr: Le Christ doit-il mourir de nouveau ?

response.en: No. The Mass is not another death of Christ but the sacramental offering of the one sacrifice by which He redeemed mankind.
response.fr: Non. La messe n'est pas une nouvelle mort du Christ, mais l'offrande sacramentelle de l'unique sacrifice par lequel il a racheté les hommes.

opening.fr: Comment assister pieusement à la messe ?
opening.en: The Catechism counsels uniting one's intention to the priest's, following the sacred actions and considering the Passion of the Lord. Private devotion is directed toward the sacrifice at the altar.

question.en: Must everyone use the same prayer book?
question.fr: Tous doivent-ils employer le même livre de prières ?

response.en: No. The catechetical counsel concerns attentive participation in the sacrifice rather than prescribing an identical form of private prayer to everyone.
response.fr: Non. Le conseil catéchétique concerne l'attention au sacrifice plutôt que l'obligation d'une forme identique de prière privée pour chacun.

opening.fr: Le chapelet est-il permis pendant la messe ?
opening.en: The longer Catechism allows the Rosary and other prayers during Mass while calling the faithful, as far as possible, to follow the action of the Holy Sacrifice.

question.en: Does that permission make the Mass secondary?
question.fr: Cette permission rend-elle la messe secondaire ?

response.en: No. The permission is joined to a reminder that the worshipper should remain attentive to the sacrificial action taking place at the altar.
response.fr: Non. Cette permission s'accompagne du rappel que le fidèle doit rester attentif à l'action sacrificielle accomplie à l'autel.

opening.fr: Que se passe-t-il à la consécration ?
opening.en: At the Consecration the substance of bread and wine is changed into the Body and Blood of Christ by His words spoken by the priest. The outward appearances remain.

question.en: Is this merely a symbol of Christ's presence?
question.fr: Est-ce simplement un symbole de la présence du Christ ?

response.en: No. The catechetical explanation affirms a real conversion of substance, traditionally called transubstantiation, not only a change of meaning.
response.fr: Non. L'explication catéchétique affirme une conversion réelle de substance, traditionnellement appelée transsubstantiation, non un simple changement de signification.

opening.fr: Pourquoi demander l'intercession de Marie auprès du Christ ?
opening.en: Ad diem illum places Mary's maternal intercession within the one saving work of Christ. Her prayer leads the faithful toward her Son rather than establishing a competing mediation.

question.en: Does Marian intercession replace the Saviour?

response.en: No. The encyclical gives Marian devotion its proper meaning through dependence on Christ, never as another source of redemption beside Him.
response.fr: Non. L'encyclique donne à la dévotion mariale son juste sens par sa dépendance du Christ, jamais comme une autre source de rédemption à côté de lui.

opening.fr: Pourquoi confesser ses péchés à un prêtre ?
opening.en: The sacrament of Penance is rooted in Christ's commission to the ministers of His Church to forgive or retain sins. Absolution is thus a sacramental act, not merely human reassurance.

response.en: No. Contrition belongs to genuine repentance, while sacramental confession and absolution are the means entrusted to the Church for reconciliation.
response.fr: Non. La contrition appartient au véritable repentir, tandis que la confession sacramentelle et l'absolution sont les moyens confiés à l'Église pour la réconciliation.

opening.fr: Comment examiner sa conscience avant la confession ?
opening.en: The Catechism advises recalling faults in thought, word, deed and omission in the light of one's duties. The purpose is an examination of concrete conduct rather than a vague impression of the day.

question.en: Should feelings alone determine what I confess?
question.fr: Les sentiments suffisent-ils à déterminer ce que l'on confesse ?

response.en: No. An examination concerns known acts and omissions and the circumstances relevant to them; a passing feeling is not itself a complete account of consent.
response.fr: Non. L'examen concerne les actes et omissions connus et leurs circonstances pertinentes ; un sentiment passager n'est pas à lui seul la mesure du consentement.

opening.fr: La peur de l'enfer peut-elle susciter le repentir ?
opening.en: The Catechism distinguishes contrition arising from love of God from imperfect contrition arising, for example, from fear of punishment. Those motives are different but imperfect sorrow is not dismissed as worthless.

question.en: Is sorrow from fear identical to sorrow from love?
question.fr: La douleur née de la crainte est-elle identique à celle née de l'amour ?

response.en: No. The distinction of perfect and imperfect contrition turns precisely on the different motives of love of God and fear of consequences.
response.fr: Non. La distinction entre contrition parfaite et imparfaite porte précisément sur les motifs différents de l'amour de Dieu et de la crainte des conséquences.

opening.fr: Doit-on restituer ce qui a été volé ?
opening.en: Repentance for theft entails restoring another's property when one can do so. Deliberately keeping goods unjustly taken is not remedied by words of regret alone.

question.en: Does forgiveness excuse refusing restitution when possible?
question.fr: Le pardon dispense-t-il de restituer quand on le peut ?

response.en: No. The catechetical teaching connects genuine repentance with the duty to repair an injustice to property as far as one's ability permits.
response.fr: Non. L'enseignement catéchétique lie le repentir sincère au devoir de réparer une injustice envers les biens d'autrui dans la mesure du possible.

opening.fr: Que produit le baptême dans l'âme ?
opening.en: Baptism remits original sin and any personal sins, gives sanctifying grace and incorporates the baptized into Christ and His Church. It is more than a public ceremony of religious belonging.

question.en: Is Baptism only a symbolic welcome?
question.fr: Le baptême n'est-il qu'un accueil symbolique ?

response.en: No. The catechetical description ascribes real sacramental effects to Baptism, including remission of sin and the beginning of supernatural life.
response.fr: Non. L'exposé catéchétique attribue au baptême de vrais effets sacramentels, notamment la rémission du péché et le commencement de la vie surnaturelle.
